model_projection.requirement: Ordinary class/record conventions, nullable values, immutable DTO constructors, required-only columns and compile diagnostics for static ambiguities.

reusable_mappings.requirement: Reusable custom ID, decimal precision and JSON mapping with provider-correct parameter and materialization behavior.

query_composition.requirement: Optional filters, joins and aggregation compose through the native query compiler; parameterized SQL and Fluent reuse DTO mapping.

cursor_relations.requirement: Composite-key cursor boundaries and batched order-detail loading cover ties and empty relations; record SQL executions separately from actual libpq protocol submissions without claiming measured physical network round trips.

writes_concurrency.requirement: Key lookup, partial updates, insert returning and optimistic concurrency distinguish unset from explicit NULL.

transaction_outcomes.requirement: Transaction callbacks preserve cancellation, rollback and unknown-commit outcome without automatic replay.

onboarding.requirement: English installation, provider-specific DI, query and redacted diagnostics tutorial matches executed examples.

migrations_scaffold.requirement: Generated reviewable migrations and compilable reverse-engineered entities; destructive operations require explicit developer selection.

module_routing.requirement: Committed-diff module plan covers affected dependencies, consumers and API checks without unrelated work.

api_compatibility.requirement: Affected compiled signatures, XML/reference coverage and meaningful positive/negative consumers pass.

postgresql_aot.requirement: Separate source-tree-external PackageReference consumer for Korda.Database.PostgreSql executes real PostgreSQL on Linux x64 Native AOT.

sqlite_aot.requirement: Separate source-tree-external PackageReference consumer for Korda.Database.Sqlite executes real SQLite on Linux x64 Native AOT.

native_reuse.requirement: A DTO-only consumer edit recompiles and runs against the same producer package/native asset hashes.

independent_review.requirement: Scoped same-team non-author review binds reviewed source and records findings/fixes without impersonating another account.

pr_checks.requirement: Each repository normal required PR checks pass for its exact reviewed head.

merged_main.requirement: Normal merges preserve the reviewed content and actual merged-main checks are observed successful.

release_observation.requirement: Inspect the Korda main release plan, every triggered publication and exact remote-feed consumer result; record a policy skip distinctly.
